verified.per_turn_reset: Before each delegated real runTurn, scenarioIndex is reset to -1 and engineIndex is set to the new call index. Only after a successful return is A cloned and scenarioIndex assigned to that call. Engine displacements/reconciliations therefore cannot be mistaken for scenario helper entries.
verified.b_capture: B[n] is captured only at the first post-return displacement whose stack contains repairScenarioArtifactState, before the real displacement function executes.
verified.c_capture: C[n] is captured only after B[n] exists and the following reconcileFinalSectorTruth call has no session. Each turn asserts exactly one verified helper entry and one such reconciliation.
verified.observer_capture: The existing observer writes its state/report into the matching zero-based week index; each turn independently records C-to-observer diffs.
topology_projection: formation identity, faction, kind, status, readiness, location_osid, assignment, assigned_sub_segment_id, and corps_id
verified.topology_decision: T2 topology_clean requires exact projected A2/B2 identity and every scenario control-flip receipt to have applied=0 with no changed controller. Created/removed formation IDs are also retained explicitly. Baseline displacement/exhaustion and other paths are classified separately rather than treated as topology.
verified.retained_b1_validation: The authentic retained B1 is cloned. Existing shape, operation-lifecycle, friendly-territory, and sector-truth validators run on the clone with operational edges. The source B1 hash, all issues/counts, created-formation fields, and before/after clone hashes are retained; the test requires exact hash equality. Control-event consistency is accurately marked unmeasured because its required turn-start snapshot is absent.
verified.capture_completeness: All A/B/C/observer runtime states, canonical persisted states, per-turn reports and diffs, mutator/session receipts, validator result, binding file, and summary report are written with exclusive creation and exactly match the 23-item wrapper allowlist.
verified.launch_contract: Exact argv uses one literal {evidenceDir}, the preserved wrapper, 180000 ms timeout, one attempt, and zero retries. The PowerShell runner passes the JSON argv as an argument array without command-text evaluation.
verified.bindings: 12/12 current hashes match the frozen plan, including test, launcher, runner, wrapper, production sources, validators, and retained A1/B1 inputs.
verified.freshness: attempt-01 and the actual scenario-output directory are absent.

authorization: Execute only FROZEN_RUN_PLAN.json exact_command_argv once. Preserve all evidence and stop on any failure; do not retry or change gameplay.
interpretation_limit: A successful run authorizes evidence interpretation only. It does not authorize the caller change until T2 satisfies the stated clean-topology predicates and retained B1 validation is reviewed.
